answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in grove, checked in comet, and fable exposes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4273 identities would post 3953 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
